authority: Archived desktop combat simulation; numeric timings are independent of PR241 studio drawing cadence. This is extraction for the later agreed Godot port, not a production integration.

units.conversion: pending integration-owner decision; no factor-three distance conversion or factor-74/96 body conversion applied

annotation_method: Global and per-character rule annotations transcribed from the pinned source; action clocks and release/contact probes executed from the original pure module.

input.primary: held, repeats when free and cooldown expires
input.special: rising edge, priority over secondary, queued for 0.7s

global_source_derived_rules.form_lifecycle: Begins at special release (0.28s), timer decreases each fixed step. Expiry ends form; death interrupts it; victory/reset clears transient objects. There is no manual E exit in this engine. Ashe's finisher occurs on natural expiry only.

projectile_origin.origin: player simulation position plus committed action direction times forward offset

aim.attack_direction: committed at action start; ordinary movement can continue at action multiplier

melee_geometry.arc: enemy centre within reach+enemy radius, forward normalized dot >= threshold
melee_geometry.line: projection from -enemy radius to reach+enemy radius and segment distance <= halfwidth+enemy radius
